label_authority: Developer-authored expected labels, not human expert acceptance or third-party blind testing.
evidence_mode: Entirely synthetic control facts; these are NOT NTE facts or evidence of live ingestion.

facts.value: Players can rent bicycles after completing the introductory quest.

draft.voiceover: Finish the introductory quest, then you can rent a bicycle.

cases.label_reason: Faithful paraphrase retaining the prerequisite; rental is not ownership.

facts.value: Players can rent bicycles after completing the introductory quest.

draft.voiceover: You own a free bicycle as soon as you enter the game.

cases.label_reason: Rental after a prerequisite does not establish free ownership at entry.

facts.value: The arcade shop sells red hats and blue jackets.

draft.caption: Red hats and blue jackets at the arcade shop.

cases.label_reason: Specified products are explicitly present; do not ban product claims in general.

facts.value: The arcade shop sells red hats and blue jackets.

draft.caption: The arcade shop's blue jackets double your defense.

cases.label_reason: A named product is not evidence of a gameplay or numerical benefit.

facts.value: The PC edition is available worldwide.

cases.label_reason: A worldwide claim is allowed when it is explicitly evidenced with matching scope.
Canadian availability does not establish Australian availability.

draft.voiceover: Luma can light up objects nearby for a short time.

cases.label_reason: The subject, duration and effect are preserved.

draft.voiceover: Rivo can light up nearby objects permanently.

cases.label_reason: Both the identity and permanent duration go beyond the evidence.

facts.value: The training arena has three rooms.

draft.voiceover: Version 2.0's training arena has three rooms.

cases.label_reason: The claim states the version and number from the provided evidence.

facts.value: The training arena has three rooms.

draft.voiceover: Every version includes six training rooms.

cases.label_reason: One version with three rooms does not support six rooms in every version.

cases.label_reason: A question still presupposes a teleportation mechanic not supported by the genre.
